# Kelir Group of Companies

> Kelir Group of Companies is an Indian food and nutrition enterprise building next-generation manufacturing for functional foods, beverages, collagen, healthy snacks, and nutrition products. Founded by Kiran Rajasekhar, the company has 17+ years of experience in the F&B industry.

## About

Kelir Group of Companies is a multidisciplinary enterprise founded by Kiran Rajasekhar, based in Tamil Nadu, India. The company operates at the intersection of food processing, functional nutrition, and modern manufacturing. Kelir Group is building scalable food manufacturing facilities for functional foods, beverages, collagen, healthy snacks, and nutrition products.

## Founders

- **Kiran Rajasekhar** — Founder & Managing Director. 17+ years in F&B, hospitality, corporate catering, institutional food service, and food manufacturing. Previously built and exited multiple ventures including Growing Today Group, Krithi Ventures, The Twisted Desi, and The Twister Express.
- **C. B. Raghavendra** — Co-Founder & Director. 20+ years across hospitality (Pizza Hut/YUM Restaurants), e-commerce logistics (Amazon), cloud kitchens (Rebel Foods), railway catering (RK Groups/IRCTC), and key account management (Smart Q).

## Business Divisions

- **OILVIKA** — Premium cooking oils and functional oils
- **BORASS** — Heritage rice and ancient grains
- **Functional Beverages** — Health-first drinks
- **Collagen** — Chicken and mutton collagen products
- **Chocolate & Chikki** — Functional indulgence snacks
- **Popped Snacks** — Healthy snacking from ancient grains and superfoods

Business Strategy, Brand Building, F&B Operations, Food Processing, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Consumer & Wellness, Global Markets, Market Entry & Growth, Food R&D, Formulation & Processing, Food Preservation & Packaging Technology

## Roadmap

- **2026**: Functional beverages, Functional chocolates & chikki, Popped snacks
- **2027**: Heritage rice products, Chicken & mutton collagen, Functional nutrition powders
- **2028**: R&D and innovation centre, Global distribution partnerships, Technology integration
